title: Build stamp slots
responsibility: Defines the embedded build stamp format and reads a filled identity without treating an empty slot as a known build.

inputs.name: buildStamp.slot
inputs.description: Optional stamp text beginning with harness-build: and followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

outputs.name: buildStampPattern
outputs.description: Global regular expression matching filled or empty harness-build slots with exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

outputs.name: sdkPackage
outputs.description: The SDK package identity reported by the console: @dafuga01/harness version 0.1.3.

outputs.name: emptyBuildStamp
outputs.description: An empty stamp slot consisting of harness-build: followed by 64 zeros.

outputs.name: buildStamp
outputs.description: The 64-character identity of a correctly shaped nonzero slot, or null for a missing, malformed or all-zero slot.
